orientation.problem: The app greets everyone with the same fixed text, so nobody can tell which build they are running.

sections.title: Greet with the feature's name
sections.explanation: The greeting now names the feature, so a run shows which build it came from.

steps.narration: Start with the old greeting. It is the same text whatever was built.
I replaced it with text that names the feature.
The picture shows the greeting before and after.

sections.title: A test and a constant to build on
sections.explanation: A placeholder test and a module constant that later work reads.

steps.narration: This constant is new and nothing reads it yet.
